verdict.rationale: Milvus documents filtered search: metadata filtering runs before the ANN search, narrowing the scope to matching entities, and metadata filtering is listed as a feature shared across deployments. The evidence never shows filtered queries keeping recall and latency, which is the second half of the story; the general performance claim versus FAISS is not about filtering. Missing for 10: evidence that recall and latency hold under restrictive filters, details on filter expressions and scalar indexing, independent or hands-on benchmarks of filtered search.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency

citations.quote: You can include filtering conditions in a search request so that Milvus conducts metadata filtering before conducting ANN searches, reducing the search scope from the whole collection to only the entities matching the specified filtering conditions.
covers most of the features such as vector data persistence and management, vector CRUD operations, sparse and dense vector search, metadata filtering, multi-vector and hybrid_search.
